bug_semantics: WithUser treats a numeric USER string that fails 32-bit uid/gid bounds as a username and looks it up in the image /etc/passwd, so a crafted passwd mapping that digit-string to UID 0 can run the container as root and evade Kubernetes runAsNonRoot (CWE-269/CWE-843).
flaw_origin: validate uid/gid folded out-of-range Atoi results into the existing username fallback (if err != nil || v < minUserID || v > maxUserID then WithUsername) instead of rejecting numeric overflow.
evidence: CVE-2026-46680 is PUBLISHED on CVE.org (state PUBLISHED, dateRejected None). GHSA-fqw6-gf59-qr4w describes numeric USER not parseable as a 32-bit integer treated as a username.
